questions.prompt: Name a move from a Pokémon video game.
questions.scope: Named moves from released Pokémon games count, including Z-Moves, Max Moves and Colosseum/XD Shadow moves. Physical/special implementations of the same named move share one answer. Generic actions and moves from fan games do not count.
questions.rationale: One whole independently chosen recognizable game concept. The full source IDs and official English names are reconciled, duplicate version labels share identity and historical public names are explicit. Types, generations, power and item properties never create extra questions.

questions.prompt: Name an item or trainer device from a Pokémon video game.

Historical versions of the same item name share one answer. Pokémon, moves and Abilities are separate concepts.
questions.rationale: One whole independently chosen recognizable game concept. The full source IDs and official English names are reconciled, duplicate version labels share identity and historical public names are explicit. Types, generations, power and item properties never create extra questions.
